rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.FlagErrorf, heredoc, opts structs as the repo does; but unexported structs with exported fields, testify imported into a non-test production file, errors.Join(nil, err) wrapping everywhere, and default alt text mangled (dots to spaces) instead of the file name.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers symlink/hard-link dupes via os.SameFile, '#' in filenames, code fences/inline code, 404/422/429; but a partial upload failure still creates the issue/PR/comment with a partial body, violating 'if one upload fails nothing is written', and issue edit drops the user's --body on failure.
rationale.scope: Feature wired into all six commands with help text; carries dead code (isSingleImage, UploadStub, always-nil error from attachAssetsToMarkdown, KeepExistingBody always true) and a rewrite of issue create's return style.
rationale.readability: references.go is ~770 lines of hand-rolled byte scanning with deep nesting and single-letter indices; client.go repeats near-identical uploadError literals six times.
rationale.robustness: Bounds checks look careful, file and response bodies closed, no obvious panics; but reference-style detection relies on an AST-count-vs-inline-count heuristic and splitAttachValue does os.Stat during flag parsing.
rationale.maintainability: Manual markdown parsing duplicates what goldmark already provides and will be fragile to extend; uploader construction is copy-pasted into six call sites; hasDeferredEdits duplicates hasDeferredFlags.
